title: PEAR upgrades died on "Failed opening
result: every package was upgraded with `--force`, so each run reinstalled current packages, and each reinstall deleted the files the registry had recorded in the Homebrew Cellar skeleton (`Cellar/php/8.5.11/share/php/pear`), which is the only include_path the bare `pear` wrapper knows. Once Archive_Tar was reinstalled into `share/pear`, every later upgrade failed, and plain `pear` in a shell later lost `System.php` too. The plugin now points the wrapper at the configured `php_dir` whenever it holds `pearcmd.php`, even when `pear list` works, and upgrades without `--force`. The Cellar was restored with `brew reinstall php`.
evidence: `tests/plugins/pear-configured-php-dir.sh` (RED before, GREEN after); the other pear tests now expect `pear upgrade <package>`; two real `./RocketUpdater.sh pear` runs each gave "Nothing to upgrade" x4 and success, with `Archive/Tar.php` and `System.php` still in the Cellar; `scripts/test-regressions.sh` and `scripts/lint.sh` (102 scripts) green.
